description: This PHP source file defines the 'Sale' model class for the OpenCart admin reporting system, providing methods to retrieve various sales and order statistics from the database, such as total sales, orders by country, day, week, month, year, as well as detailed order and tax information.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: A model class within the Opencart admin reporting module that provides methods for fetching sales data from the database.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Retrieves the total sales amount, optionally filtered by a specific date.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders and the sum of their totals grouped by country.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByDay
methods.description: Returns an array of order counts per hour for the current day, filtered by order status.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByWeek
methods.description: Provides the count of orders for each day of the current week.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByMonth
methods.description: Returns the count of orders for each day of the current month.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByYear
methods.description: Returns the number of orders per month for the current year.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves detailed order data with filters like status, date range, and grouping (day, week, month, year).

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total count of orders based on filters and grouping.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Fetches tax-related summaries, including total tax amount and count, optionally grouped by day, week, month, or year.

methods.name: getTotalTaxes
methods.description: Provides the total number of tax records matching the filters.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Provides shipping cost summaries and count of shipping records, filtered by various conditions.

methods.name: getTotalShipping
methods.description: Returns the total number of shipping records based on filters.
